title: Home Service Passbook
summary: Track recurring home care and keep proof in a private passbook.
user: Households that want to remember recurring home care and retain proof of what was done, without tying maintenance to appliance-cloud apps.
smallest_useful_product: Offline PWA with assets and areas, fixed and completion-relative schedules, completion notes and proof, and printable history.
constraints: Local-first attachment storage with explicit export; no safety certification or repair advice; durable backup/import format required.
